name: token-razor
description: Tool used to build LLM Context from source code and documentation, and to explore the relationships between entities in a graph to limit the token usage.

commands.title: Token Razor - 02 --> ➕ Add selected file to Graph RAG Explorer

tokenRazor.pinApplication.description: Automatically pin the Application UI tab when opened.

tokenRazor.codebaseScanEachTimeAppIsDisp.description: Automatically start code scan each time the application UI is displayed.

tokenRazor.tooltipDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing the custom tooltips on hover.

tokenRazor.geminiApiKey.description: API Key for Gemini Assistant analysis.

tokenRazor.backendWorkspacePath.description: Local User Path where the back-end scripts and treatment results will be stored (relative to the workspace root).

tokenRazor.forceScriptSync.description: Force synchronized recreation of local workspace core scripts.

tokenRazor.logFileMaxSize.description: Maximum size per log file before rotation triggers (in Megabytes).

tokenRazor.logFileMaxCountRetention.description: Maximum number of historical log file nodes to keep before cycling.

tokenRazor.processTimeout.description: Default external process timeout in milliseconds (python scripts, sh scripts, ...).

tokenRazor.processSoundPath.description: Path to the sound file to play upon process completion (if empty, no sound will be played). It could be on MacOS: /System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff or on Windows: C:\Windows\Media\notify.wav or on Linux: /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga

tokenRazor.processSoundDelay.description: If process takes longer than this value in milliseconds, the process completion sound will be played. If set to <=0, the sound will be disabled.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.entitiesType.description: List of predefined entity types for the graph exploration.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.regexFilterE.description: Enable Regex matching in the filter bar by default.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.treeFilterEn.description: Apply search filters on the Tree View by default.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.graphLegendE.description: Display the visual topological legend by default upon launch.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.callersDepth.description: Default callers upstream lookup relationship parsing depth.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.calleesDepth.description: Default callees downstream lookup relationship parsing depth.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.backendWorks.description: Local User Path where the back-end scripts and treatment results will be stored (relative to the workspace root).

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.includePaths.description: Regex to include only paths containing specific directories.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.includeExten.description: Regex to include paths containing specific file extensions.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.excludePaths.description: Regex to exclude paths containing specific directories (! /target is not included because we need classes).

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.excludeExten.description: Regex to exclude paths containing specific file extensions.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.neo4j.versio.description: The specific community release version of the local sandboxed database engine server.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.neo4j.port.b.description: Neo4j connection endpoint port used to access db API.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.neo4j.uri.description: Neo4j connection endpoint mapping into the embedded jQAssistant server database.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.neo4j.userna.description: Database account access identifier username. Should not change with the default Neo4j community installation.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.neo4j.passwo.description: Database secure transaction authorization secret credentials. Should not change with the default Neo4j community installation.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.jqassistant..description: The target production-ready release version of the portable jQAssistant CLI tool.
The absolute parameterized GitHub Releases download link for fetching portable jQAssistant distribution packages.
The base URL of the GraphRag LLM model used to generate graph-based semantic embeddings on codebase.
The LLM model used to generate graph-based semantic embeddings on codebase.
The minimum cyclomatic complexity required for the GraphRag LLM model to analyze a method.

The maximum number of analyzer calls allowed by element type (method, type, sourceFile, directory, package, project) for the GraphRag LLM model. 0 = unlimited. (used mainly at dev step to avoid too many calls to the LLM model)

The maximum number of summarizer calls allowed by element type (method, type, sourceFile, directory, package, project) for the GraphRag LLM model. 0 = unlimited. (used mainly at dev step to avoid too many calls to the LLM model)
The host address for the jqassistant MCP server.
The port for the jqassistant MCP server.
Workspace matching path targeting local JaCoCo XML metric reports.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.dependencyCr.description: Configuration rules path definition for Dependency Cruiser checks.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.graphify.arg.description: Optional runtime execution flags passed onto the background python graphify engine.

tokenRazor.graphRagExplorer.userPreferen.description: User preferences for the GraphRag Explorer extension in JSON format as an array of strings (one by line, for better readability).

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:webview
